name: Cerebras Systems Inc.
blurb: Cerebras Systems is an AI infrastructure company that designs and manufactures wafer-scale processors purpose-built for AI training and inference, most notably its Wafer Scale Engine. The company builds complete AI supercomputer systems—hardware, cooling, networking, and software—and also offers inference-as-a-service at speeds it claims are unattainable on conventional GPU-based alternatives. With 708 employees and trailing-twelve-month revenue of approximately $510 million (up ~548% year-over-year), Cerebras targets hyperscalers, AI labs, and enterprises running large-scale model training and inference workloads using familiar ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
recent: Cerebras completed the largest IPO of 2026 on May 14, 2026, pricing 30 million shares at $185 each and raising $5.55 billion. Shares nearly doubled on debut, closing at $311.07 (+68.15%) and continuing higher in pre-market trading on May 15 to approximately $330, giving the company a market capitalization of roughly $67 billion. The bull case centers on a high-profile inference partnership with OpenAI, though analysts have flagged customer concentration risk as a key concern.
